pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit complex, irregular polygonal geometries with highly crenellated (jagged) edge gradients. The spatial area of individual patches is large on the upper flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented clusters toward the ventral and lower neck regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored inter-patch spaces form a continuous, interconnected topological grid. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial intersections. The pixel thickness of these pathways is narrow and consistent across the mid-flank, widening at the transition to the ventral midline.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D silhouette. The profile is composed of short, dense, vertical bristly filaments that create a continuous jagged edge against the background sky and foliage.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian symbiont (oxpecker) is visible perched on the upper dorsal ridge near the shoulder. A prominent anatomical protrusion is visible on the ventral midline.
